verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented setting that lets users opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The closest item is an enterprise option, arranged through an account manager, to keep organization data out of AI model training. That is an adjacent control about training data, not telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
